messages:
aj: quick question — we're seeing repeated 100ms tail latencies for org-level bursts even though per-key buckets look fine. thinking we need a hybrid token/leaky approach. thoughts?

maya: do you have an example trace? is it concentrated on a few keys or many small keys spiking simultaneously?

aj: mostly many small keys within same org, short 5-10s spikes. token buckets per-key happily allow microbursts, but org-level queuing causes transient head-of-line.

sasha: short bursts across many keys -> aggregate rate hits org quota and we hit queueing on the serving runtime. leaky-bucket at org level smooths, but kills short legitimate spikes.

tom: what if we keep per-key token buckets for latency-sensitive paths and add an org-level leaky envelope with a small burst credit pool? i.e. allow soft bursts up to X tokens then slow to sustained rate R.

aj: exactly. proposal: per-key TB (rate r_k, burst b_k), org-level LB with capacity C_org and drain rate R_org. also hold a tiny grace window for new keys to prevent cold-start drops.

sasha: +1. need to be careful with fairness — a noisy key shouldn't drain all org capacity. suggest hierarchical refill where each key has a reserve and org pool only used when reserve depleted with proportionate backoff.

maya: can you paste the sample config you'd roll out? easier to review with numbers.

aj: sure:
```
rate_limits:
  keys:
    default: { rate: 1 req/s, burst: 6 }
  org:
    envelope_capacity: 1200 tokens
    envelope_drain: 200 tokens/s
    per_key_reserve_fraction: 0.1
    grace_window_s: 8
```

tom: looks reasonable. two concerns: 1) how to measure when envelope kicks in (useful for dashboarding) 2) rollout plan + canary thresholds.

sasha: add metrics: org_envelope_utilization, per_key_reserve_remaining, envelope_replenish_rate. Instrument tags: org_id, key_id, route.

maya: dashboard wants 95/99 latencies pre/post envelope, tokens_consumed_by_envelope, rejected_vs_throttled. add alert if envelope usage > 70% for > 30s.

aj: rollout idea: start 0% -> 5% prod traffic with envelope enabled for a few orgs (select low-risk customers) -> monitor 24h -> 25% with automatic rollback if error budget impact > 0.3% or median latency increase > 10ms.

tom: canary behind feature-flag: org_envelope_v1. add kill-switch: if we detect abnormal drop_rate toggle permissive mode.

sasha: i'll also make a loadbench pattern that simulates N small keys spiking in one org. will post gist.

aj: billing note: envelope tokens should be attributable; customers should see envelope consumption on billing dashboard.

maya: agree. show envelope tokens as separate line item and include forecast if envelope hits sustained usage.

tom: ops: watch Redis counter latencies; org-level envelope will increase shared counter contention. consider sharded counters.

rate-limit-bot: deploy queued: rate-limit-service v3.8.0 -> staging. test-run id: rl-20251123-78.

aj: thanks all. sasha, can you drop the loadbench gist link here when ready? :thumbsup:

sasha: dropping gist in #eng-runtime in a min.
